text:
sam: Heads-up — the shared GPU pool in us-west-2 is hitting sustained 98% utilization, queue depth for small-inference jobs spiked x6 after the import from tenant-omega around 18:12 UTC. Observing long tail p99 latency > 3s.
anya: Which pool? is this the 'shared-lowprio' one? any noisy tenant id?
sam: shared-lowprio. noisy tenant looks like omega-prod (high-concurrency small requests, lots of short sequences). They ramped from 50rps->1200rps.
leo: putting on paging radar. Repro: run `rbctl admission status --pool shared-lowprio --window 5m` shows 92% batching util and 400 queued requests.
maria: can we soft-evict or apply per-tenant shaping? current token-bucket config is too permissive.
sam: I pushed a temporary rate cap for omega to 60rps via `rbctl tenant update --id omega-prod --rate 60` to buy time. Watch the impact.
autoscaler-bot: autoscaler: requested +2 nodes for pool shared-lowprio (pending allocation in us-west-2), ETA ~3m.
anya: good. long term we should do: 1) per-tenant adaptive pacing based on recent latency+cost signals 2) prefix-caching hinting for omega 3) soft preemption for tiny cheap requests.
leo: agree. Also want a fairness metric: normalized tokens/sec per amortized GPU-second. That helps compare small vs large jobs.
dmitri: question — will token-normalized fairness penalize many tiny requests? we still want to protect customers with latency-critical small calls.
maria: propose a two-tier credit system: latency-sensitive tokens (higher weight) vs bulk tokens (lower weight). admission picks by route tag.
sam: sounds good. For now, rollout steps: a) keep temporary cap b) enable queue-length-based backpressure that rejects/degrades to hosted-lite model (lower-cost variant) c) monitor for 30m.
anya: I'll file a short RFC for credit system and backpressure policy, include simulation results.
sam: FYI I see a spike in network retransmits on node gpu-12, could be tcp/mtu causing slowdowns — opening infra ticket.
leo: thx. if network is part of it, autoscaler won't fully help. keep us posted.
deploy-bot: rate-limit change applied to tenant omega-prod by sam at 18:22 UTC :white_check_mark:
sam: after cap, queue depth down ~55% and p99 latencies improved to ~1.1s. leaving cap for 20m then iterate.
anya: :thumbsup:

---

Sample command output (from leo) to illustrate the queue snapshot:
```
$ rbctl admission status --pool shared-lowprio --window 5m
pool: shared-lowprio
batching_util: 0.92
queued_requests: 412
active_batches: 87
top_tenant: omega-prod (51%)
avg_latency_p50_p99: 120ms / 3100ms
```

Notes: temporary cap + backpressure + credit system RFC are the immediate next actions. Keeping this thread for sync and follow-up on the RFC + infra ticket.
